title: Project Coordinator, Infrastructure Solutions
description:
Job Description
Job Title           : Project Coordinator
Job location    : Anderson SC
Duration           : 06+ month contract with possibility for extension
 
Job Description:
• Document meeting notes, action items and follow through to completion.
• Maintaining project program tracking tools ensuring all new projects and major project milestones are accurately tracked.
• Compiling regular project reports focusing on the main project related financial, product, and regional KPI’s.
• Provide regular customer-facing reporting to track and forecast project progress.
• Ensuring projects plans are maintained and accurately reflect current project status.
• Support the Project Management team by completing administrative and co-ordination activities relating to engineering project processes.
• Generating and submitting project related documentation to the client (Technical Submittals, Test Documents, O&M’s, BOLs, Shipping Logs etc.).
• Liaising with key internal and external Stakeholders, (i.e. Client, Production, Logistics, Site Teams, Accounts, etc.) ensuring efficient product delivery.
• Coordinating site activities with field service and production teams.
• Other duties as assigned.

• Experience in project, manufacturing, or construction management.
• Advance knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint internet-based principles.
• Proficient ERP and/or CRM experience is a bonus
• Smartsheet and PoweBI knowledge is a bonus.
• Demonstrates ability to plan, set priorities, organizes and coordinates work with others.
• Knowledge of construction, electrical and mechanical contracting.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
• Excellent customer service skills
• Excellent project management skills
• Detail-oriented
• Excellent organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills
• Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing processes, data center infrastructure and commissioning processes is helpful.

title: Laboratory Technician (General) 4
description:
JOB DUTIES:
Responsible for post-silicon lab activities related to performance and power characterization, optimization and validation of pre-production CPU/GPU products. The following is a list of key responsibilities that the candidate will assume: Setup power and performance measurement platforms, execute power and performance test plans, support lab debug activities.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:
Associate?s or Bachelors degree in Electronics/Computer Engineering or Computer Science; 8-10 years of relevant work experience, Good understanding of PC system architecture, operating systems, drivers, ACPI and BIOS; Performance/Power/Thermal related lab work experience is an asset; Strong analytical/problem solving skills and pronounced attention to detail; Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

title: Civil Process Specialist
description:
Job Title: Civil Process Specialist
Duration: 9+ months from the date of start
Location: 100% Remote

 
Duties:
  • Responsible for processing claims to customer funds received from third parties.
  • Claims include garnishments, levies, liens and information subpoenas received from creditors and taxing authorities.
  • Also responsible for processing 1099-K corrections for customers.
 
Job duties include:
  • Examine garnishments, levies, liens and information subpoenas to ensure accuracy, completeness and legal sufficiency.
  • Review account files to determine whether any customer accounts platform are implicated.
  • Restrain and release funds held in accounts.
  • Prepare response documents and submit responses to third parties according to established timelines and legal requirements.
  • Communicate with customers, creditors, taxing authorities, attorneys and officers of the court.
  • Maintain tracking system and provide details supporting actions taken in the event of escalations.
  • Assist customers with making 1099-K tax form corrections
 
Skills: 
  • Strong time management skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of reading comprehension
  • Strong organization skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficient in Google docs & sheets
  • Experience with lien, levy or garnishment processing strongly encouraged
  • Experience with 1099-K tax form corrections a plus
